demoStrip.title:
Real templates.

demoStrip.description: Each template is self-contained HTML — Tailwind + Google Fonts inline, no React runtime. Clone, edit copy + images, deploy to your subdomain.

features.title: Built for people who'd rather <muted>own software</muted> than rent it.

templates.title: {count} production templates
templates.body: Hand-built marketing landings + 30 link-in-bio creator hubs (streamer, musician, photographer, indie maker). Pick one, customize in-iframe, publish to your subdomain.

analytics.title: Privacy-first analytics built in
analytics.body: Per-link click tracking, page visits, top referrers, country split — no cookies, no IP storage, no consent banner. GDPR-clear by design. Same model as Plausible, but yours.

ownHtml.title: Your HTML, your subdomain
ownHtml.body: Pure HTML + Tailwind output. Publish to '<you>'.openlen.com instantly, or take the file and host anywhere — Vercel, Cloudflare, GitHub Pages, your own server. No runtime lock-in.

openSource.title: Open source (AGPLv3)
openSource.body: Fork it. Audit it. Self-host the whole stack on a single Hetzner box. Generator, editor, publish pipeline, and analytics all live in the repo.

analyticsLeads.title: Know your traffic. <muted>Capture every lead.</muted>
analyticsLeads.subtitle: Privacy-first analytics and lead forms, built into every page you publish — no Google Analytics, no cookies, no consent banner. And the data is yours.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.chartAria: Pageviews and visitors over the last 30 days

leads.title: Leads
leads.msg1: Interested in the team plan — can we book a quick call this week?
leads.msg2: Loved the page! Do you ship to Mexico, and what are the lead times?
leads.msg3: Quote request for 50 units — what volume pricing can you offer?
leads.emailNotice: Every submission is stored and emailed to you instantly

privacy.title: Privacy-first by default
privacy.body: No cookies, no consent banner, no IP storage. GDPR-clear — the same model as Plausible, but yours.

perLink.title: Per-link click tracking
perLink.body: See which links, buttons, and CTAs people actually click — not just page views.

inbox.title: Leads land in your inbox
inbox.body: Add a form to any page. Submissions are saved and emailed to you the moment they arrive.

kit.title: Marketing Kit
kit.body: Ready-to-post social graphics matched to your page — same palette, same font, contrast-safe. Pick one, tweak the caption, post.

coach.title: Page Coach
coach.tip: Move the WhatsApp button above the fold — 62% of visitors never scroll past the hero.
coach.body: Reads your funnel and tells you exactly what to fix — where visitors drop off and which change wins them back.

modules.title: Modules, one switch away
modules.body: Bookings, WhatsApp orders, members, comments, chat — flip one on and it becomes a brand-matched section of your page.

comparison.title: We did the math, so you don't have to.
